logp.method_description: The partition coefficient P was examined using the “shake flask” method as per the previously reported protocol.14a Complexes 1–3 and cisplatin were dissolved in a mixture of n-octanol and water and were shaken for 24 h. The mixture was allowed to settle over a period of half an hour. The resulting two phases were separated carefully without cross contamination of one solvent layer into another. The results were given as the mean values taken from three independent experiments. Finally, the concentration of the complexes 1–3 and cisplatin in each phase was analyzed by UV-vis absorption spectroscopy at room temperature. Partition coefficients for complexes 1–3 and cisplatin were calculated from the following equation logP = log[(complexes 1–3 and cisplatin)oct/(complexes 1–3 and cisplatin)aq].
